name: md-root-module-repo-relative
body: Reconciliation of `requirements.requirement.md-lang-id-preserved` and `requirements.constraint.md-fqn-stability` (spec-review feedback-3) [with user, option (a)]. Source statement: the requirement demanded the post-change `md.*` module FQN set be identical to the pre-change set. Inconsistency: the pre-change set contains the repo-root module `md.apg`, derived from the checkout basename — `rust.mdfrontend.walk`/`rust.mdfrontend.build_doc` (`src/mdlib/src/main.rs:229-246`, `484-535`) emit the file's absolute parent dir as the module identity, and `rust.apg.ingest.repo_relative_identity` (`src/ingest.rs:122-177`) falls back to `file_name(base)` when the dir equals the base — so enshrining it contradicts `requirements.requirement.portable-graph-identity`, `requirements.requirement.frontend-rooting-from-repo-base`, `requirements.constraint.no-checkout-named-module` and `domain.value.module-identity`. Resolution: narrowed `requirements.constraint.md-fqn-stability` to the NON-ROOT `md.*` identities, updated `requirements.requirement.md-lang-id-preserved` so it asserts the heading/dir FQNs are preserved while the repo-root module moves `md.apg` → `md.` (SPEC.md §4.3's `<repo-relative-dir>` rule, the reading matching the brief's `toml.` example), and corrected `requirements.note.structural-file-graphing-reconciliation`. Verified anchors (all resolve in the branch graph): `rust.mdfrontend.walk`, `rust.mdfrontend.build_doc`, `rust.apg.ingest.repo_relative_identity`. The heading Structs are file-rooted (`md.<repo-relative-file>.md.<heading>`, e.g. `md.AGENTS.md.apg-agent-guide`), so they do not embed the module identity and stay unchanged. [with user]
